subject.title: [Control UI] 部分模块中文翻译缺失

question: How should maintainers sequence the overlapping Control UI zh-CN localization work for Agents, Skills, Nodes, Sessions, Channels, Settings, and generated locale artifacts?
rationale: The remaining work is real, but multiple partial PRs already overlap generated outputs and some have correctness/proof blockers, so automation should not open another broad fix PR without maintainer sequencing direction.

options.title: Sequence Focused PR Slices
options.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker and ask contributors or maintainers to refresh focused page-specific PRs in a defined order with one final i18n regeneration per slice.

options.title: Consolidate Into Maintainer Branch
options.body: Close or supersede stale contributor branches only after a maintainer-owned replacement branch carries their useful work and credits the source PRs.

options.title: Narrow To Current Open PRs
options.body: Split the broad tracker into narrower canonical page issues and use this issue only as an umbrella reference, accepting more tracking overhead.

recommendation.title: Sequence Focused PR Slices
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the broad tracker and ask contributors or maintainers to refresh focused page-specific PRs in a defined order with one final i18n regeneration per slice.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the Control UI i18n pipeline and generated locale sequencing, where vincentkoc has the strongest current history signal.
